title: Sage on the Stage
lines: Ben has a huge cage on the stage.
"This is Sage, my pet rat," he said.
Sage hops from the cage and runs off!
The class gasps, but Ben is brave.
He sets a bit of ham on a page.
The rat sniffs the ham and runs back.
Ben shuts the cage and grins.
"That rat and his ham!" he said.

questions.listenFor: Ben's pet rat. He says so in the second line.

questions.ask: How does Ben get Sage to come back?
questions.listenFor: He sets a bit of ham on a page. Send them back to that line.

questions.ask: Do you think Ben had a good plan? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for a reason, such as "yes, because Sage came back for the ham."
